##### Project general facts

MBL Royal by MAG Properties Development is a striking residential tower created around the idea of a truly fine lifestyle, where high-quality living, unique activities and incredible amenities come together. The project offers a refined collection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom luxury apartments, each designed as an ultra-comfortable suite with mesmerizing interior and exterior features. With spacious floor plans and a variety of layouts to choose from, this waterfront residence makes it easy for every resident to find a home that feels perfectly suited to them.

Life at MBL Royal is enriched by a wonderful selection of amenities that cover wellness, leisure and everyday convenience alike. Residents can enjoy a fully-equipped gymnasium, a steam room and sauna, a relaxing jacuzzi, and a beautiful podium-level outdoor swimming pool with a leisure deck, complemented by separate adult and family pool areas. The tower also offers a dedicated children's play area, a barbecue area, attentive concierge service, generous car parking, retail shops with restaurants and cafés, and round-the-clock security for complete peace of mind.

The apartments are finished to an exceptionally high standard, with elegant marble-toned flooring, warm wood and stone accents, and sculptural lighting that gives every space a sense of occasion. Kitchens are beautifully appointed with sleek handleless cabinetry, dark marble countertops and branded white goods, while high-end fittings and fixtures are used throughout the homes. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the interiors with natural light, and the grand lobby and lift lobbies extend the same luxurious material palette across the entire building.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) is a vibrant waterfront community. JLT is situated in the heart of "New Dubai" and is known for its stunning views of the adjacent man-made lakes and the Dubai Marina skyline. The development also encompasses a significant number of office towers, making it a popular destination for businesses and professionals. The state-of-the-art office spaces cater to a wide range of industries and offer a dynamic working environment.

One of the defining features of JLT is the four man-made lakes that are beautifully integrated into the community. These lakes create a scenic environment and serve as focal points for recreational activities. Additionally, JLT offers landscaped parks and jogging tracks, providing residents and visitors with ample opportunities for outdoor leisure. Also, JLT boasts a diverse range of retail outlets, including supermarkets, convenience stores, boutiques, and specialty shops. Residents and visitors can also enjoy a wide array of dining options, with numerous cafes and restaurants offering various cuisines.

JLT benefits from its strategic location, providing convenient access to major highways and public transportation. The development is well-connected to other parts of Dubai, making commuting easy for residents and visitors alike.
